description: Source file implementing functions for model compatibility checking in PyTorch JIT mobile, including bytecode version extraction, operator info retrieval, type table analysis, and compatibility validation.

classes.name: ModelCompatibilityInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a model’s bytecode version, operator info, contained types, and operator version for compatibility checks.

classes.name: ModelCompatCheckResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a model compatibility check, including status and error messages.

classes.name: RuntimeCompatibilityInfo
classes.description: Contains runtime environment details such as supported types, operator version range, and supported bytecode versions.

classes.name: OperatorInfo
classes.description: Stores information about an operator, including the number of schema arguments.

methods.name: readArchive
methods.description: Reads an archive from a stream or filename, returning IValue data.

methods.name: get_bytecode_ivalues
methods.description: Extracts bytecode IValues from a PyTorchStreamReader.

methods.name: _get_model_bytecode_version
methods.description: Determines the model's bytecode version from various input sources.

methods.name: _get_model_operator_version
methods.description: Retrieves the operator version from a model archive.

methods.name: _get_model_ops_and_info
methods.description: Extracts operator information from model bytecode.

methods.name: _get_mobile_model_contained_types
methods.description: Gets a set of unique type names used in the model bytecode.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to obtain ModelCompatibilityInfo from an input stream.

methods.name: is_compatible
methods.description: Checks if a model is compatible with a given runtime environment.
